idea: Themed weeks, week five, Women day: written from the source, then corrected by a numbers editor and a viewer editor before voicing.
description: In Karnataka, 82.7% of married women aged 15 to 49 usually took part in all three household decisions (their own health care, major household purchases and visits to family or relatives), alone or with their husband, in NFHS-5 (2019-21); in NFHS-6 (2023-24) it was 89.2%, a rise of 6.5 points.

India's figure went from 88.7% to 89.0%, up 0.3 points. Karnataka started 6.0 points below India and ended 0.2 points above it, which is level: these are survey estimates, and a gap of 0.2 points is not a difference. The Short claims no rank for Karnataka's rise. The map has the 32 states and UTs with both figures; it leaves out Rajasthan and Uttarakhand (no figure in our copy), Lakshadweep (small sample) and Manipur (no NFHS-6 sheet yet). The table shows how much, not why.
source: International Institute for Population Sciences, National Family Health Survey: NFHS-6 (2023-24) state fact sheets, which also print the NFHS-5 (2019-21) figure. done: Writer recomputed Karnataka's rise from the NFHS-6 state sheets (82.7% to 89.2%, +6.5 points; India 88.7% to 89.0%, +0.3) and claims no rank, since Karnataka's rise is fourth of 32 states and UTs, tied with one UT. Numbers editor checked every print, confirmed NFHS-5 Karnataka 82.7 and India 88.7 against a second source (Karnataka's NFHS-6 89.2 could not be confirmed on the web), and fixed the hook and title ('a say in all three decisions', not 'household decisions') and the map key ('fell over 3', because Odisha's -3.0 sits in the lighter band). Viewer editor put 2019-21 and 2023-24 in place of the survey codes on the statement card.
open: Read the Karnataka and India cells in the NFHS-6 fact sheets (89.2 / 82.7 and 89.0 / 88.7, row 'usually participate in three household decisions') and the exact row label and age band

Read Karnataka's NFHS-4 figure for this row in the NFHS-5 Karnataka sheet; if it is 82.7 or higher, the NFHS-5 start is a dip and the figure must be shown
Owner to accept the loosened min_change (0.05 against the builder default 0.10); the rise is 7.9% in relative terms
